failures.note: This guard comes from a defect measured on live animedia.icu and animedia.space (TEMPLATE-POSTDEPLOY-ACCEPTANCE-01, 6/6 on two domains and three widths): the .zt__none placeholder is position:absolute, so a poster without its own layer is painted over by the 'poster failed to load' caption. The zona stylesheet carries the explicit z-index:1; the animedia one did not. In practice the poster still won, but only because the follows the placeholder in document order — an accident of markup order, which is precisely the fragility the guard exists to forbid.
failures.action: SOURCE REPAIRED — z-index:1 added to .ztitle__poster img/.zhead__img and .aep-ctx__poster img/.zhead__img, making the layer explicit. The test's selector lookup was widened to the two scoped Animedia containers, because .zhead__ps is display:contents in this design and the frame is owned by .ztitle__poster and .aep-ctx__poster.
